Few groups in the last century were as bold in their exploration of theses new modes of creative expression than Gutai. We mention in our Generative Art Timeline how impactful and ahead of their time they were in 1950s Japan. How does your work build on Gutai’s traditions of uncoupling and unlearning from cognitive patterns of the past? What is your work looking to uncouple from the past?
